fact: On 16 February 2026 the government held a workshop to launch the national administrative-procedures portal Ijraati, with the most requested procedures to be fully digitised and integrated into the Khidmaty platform.
title: افتتاح ورشة عمل حول إطلاق بوابة الإجراءات والمساطر الإدارية "إجراءاتي"
